semanticDecisions: the flat side is converted, never the native side: the storage stays untouched and is compared in place by the A12 vectorized mismatch
a UTF-16 flat window that compress refuses (a unit above 0xff) is compared per unit: such a unit never equals a Latin-1 storage byte, so the loop ends at or before it
UTF-16 storage in foreign byte order and counts below 64 units keep the M3StringOwner window loop
the remaining distance to flat is the UTF-16 in-place vectorized compare itself (the 1.6x the same-coder UTF-16 rows carry) plus the inflate
